## Settings

```{r settings}
library(correlation)
library(nFactors)
library(dplyr)
library(irr)
library(psych)
library(corrr)
library(rempsyc)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Exclusions

3 types:
- Pre-registration (PRG)
- Exclusion of GNG GO > 90 and Effort 100 (NEW)
- No exlusions (full)

```{r}
# Exclusion of GNG GO > 90 and Effort 100
prg_excluded_day2 <- c()

prg_excluded_day2 <- c()

```

## Load data
```{r load_data}
# Day 1

constrained_quadratic_day1 <- read.csv("comp_modelling/session1/physical_effort_params_retest.csv")
data_day1 <- read.csv("comp_modelling/session1_comp_params.csv")
data_day1 <- data_day1 %>%
  select(-c(phys_beta, phys_k))

quest_data_day1_full_id <- read.csv("../output/session1/questionnaire_scores.csv")

# Reduce the rows based on subjID in data_day1
quest_data_day1 <- quest_data_day1_full_id %>%
  filter(paste0("output/",subjID) %in% data_day1$subjID) %>%
  select(-subjID)


quest_data_day1_full <- quest_data_day1_full_id %>%
  select(-subjID)

data_day1_quests <- cbind(data_day1,quest_data_day1)

# Day 2

constrained_quadratic_day2 <- read.csv("comp_modelling/session2/physical_effort_params_retest.csv")
data_day2 <- read.csv("comp_modelling/session2_comp_params.csv")
data_day2 <- data_day2 %>%
  select(-c(phys_beta, phys_k, phys_g))

quest_data_day2_full_id <- read.csv("../output/session2/questionnaire_scores.csv")

quest_data_day2_full_id <- quest_data_day2_full_id %>%
  mutate(subjID = ifelse(subjID == "67e6e73a9192e805dad3a03", "67e6e73a9a192e805dad3a03", subjID))

quest_data_day2_full <- quest_data_day2_full_id %>%
  select(-subjID)
  

quest_data_day2 <- quest_data_day2_full_id %>%
  filter(paste0("output/",subjID) %in% data_day2$subjID) %>%
  select(-subjID)

data_day2_quests <- cbind(data_day2,quest_data_day2)

# Remove "output/" prefix from subjID before
data_day1$subjID <- gsub("output/", "", data_day1$subjID)
data_day2$subjID <- gsub("output/", "", data_day2$subjID)

# Remove "output/" prefix from subjID in questionnaire data
data_day1_quests$subjID <- gsub("output/", "", data_day1_quests$subjID)
data_day2_quests$subjID <- gsub("output/", "", data_day2_quests$subjID)

```
# Day 1


```{r day1}
# Full data no exclusions

data_day1_constrained_quadratic_full <- cbind(data_day1, constrained_quadratic_day1)


# Data with questionnaires

data_day1_constrained_quadratic_full_quests <- cbind(data_day1_quests, constrained_quadratic_day1)


```
# PRG Exclusions

```{r prg_exclusions_day1}
data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_full %>%
  filter(!subjID %in% prg_excluded_day1 )

# Data with questionnaires
data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_quests <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_full_quests %>%
  filter(!subjID %in% prg_excluded_day1 )
```

### Constrained quadratic (PRG)

```{r constrained_quadratic_prg}

# Factor analysis using factanal
fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg %>%
  select(rlwm_alpha, gng_beta, gng_eps, foraging_exit_threshold, k)  # Exclude non-FA relevant columns

# DO PCA and screeplot
pca_result <- prcomp(fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Base R scree plot
screeplot(pca_result, type = "lines", main = "Scree Plot")

fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg <- factanal(
  fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg,
  factors = 2,
  rotation = "varimax",
  scores = "regression"
)

# Add factor scores to the data
data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_with_factors <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg %>%
  mutate(
    factor1 = fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg$scores[, 1],
    factor2 = fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg$scores[, 2]
  )

# Add factor scores to the quests data
data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_quests <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_quests %>%
  mutate(
    factor1 = fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg$scores[, 1],
    factor2 = fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg$scores[, 2]
  )

# Reduce the quests data for better readability
data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_quests <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_quests %>%
  select(subjID,factor1,factor2,behavioral_activation,emotional_sensitivity,social_motivation,Score_ASRM,Score_CESD,Score_SHPS,Score_PSS,BIS,BAS_Drive,BAS_Fun,BAS_Reward, rlwm_alpha, gng_beta, gng_eps, foraging_exit_threshold, k) #%>%
  # mutate(rt_average = rt_foraging + rt_effort / 2)

# Parameters correlation matrix
correlation_matrix_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg <- correlation(
  data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_quests,
  method = "spearman",
  progress = FALSE
)

# Plot the correlation matrix
correlation_matrix_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg %>%
  summary(redundant = TRUE) %>%
  plot()

## Print nice factor analysis ##
fa_temp <- fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg$loadings[, 1:2] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Parameter = rownames(fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg$loadings)) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = recode(Parameter,
                           "rlwm_alpha" = "RLWM Alpha",
                           "gng_beta" = "GNG Beta",
                           "gng_eps" = "GNG Epsilon",
                           "foraging_exit_threshold" = "Foraging Exit Threshold",
                           "k" = "Effort Kappa")) %>%
  select(Parameter, Factor1, Factor2)

#### Testing 1 factor solution of vigor params ####
fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_only_vigor <- fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg %>%
  select(gng_eps, foraging_exit_threshold, k)  

fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_only_vigor <- factanal(
  fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_only_vigor,
  factors = 1,
  rotation = "varimax",
  scores = "regression"
)

# Parameters correlation matrix


data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_vigor_with_factors <- fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_only_vigor %>%
  mutate(
    factor1 = fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_only_vigor$scores[, 1]
  )



correlation_matrix_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg %>%
  summary(redundant = TRUE) %>%
  plot()

# Add the questionnaires to the factor analysis data
fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_only_vigor_quests <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_quests %>%
  select(subjID, behavioral_activation, emotional_sensitivity, social_motivation, Score_ASRM, Score_CESD, Score_SHPS) %>%
  bind_cols(factor1 = data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_vigor_with_factors$factor1)

correlation_matrix_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg <- correlation(
  fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_only_vigor_quests,
  method = "spearman"
)
  
# Nice table
  nice_fa_temp <- nice_table(fa_temp, title = c("Table 1","Factor Analysis"))
  print(nice_fa_temp, preview = "docx")
  
# Reduced correlation matrix for the presentation
correlation_matrix_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_reduced <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_quests %>%
  select(subjID, factor1, factor2, behavioral_activation, emotional_sensitivity, social_motivation, Score_ASRM, Score_CESD, Score_SHPS) %>%
  correlation(method = "spearman", p_adjust = "none")

# Step 2: Filter to keep only rows where one parameter is factor1 or factor2
corr_filtered <- correlation_matrix_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_reduced %>%
  filter(Parameter1 %in% c("factor1", "factor2") & !Parameter2 %in% c("factor1", "factor2"))

# Print a matrix
correlation_matrix_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_reduced %>%
  summary(redundant = FALSE) %>%
  plot(p_adjust = "none") 

# Flip if needed so all variables are in a consistent column
corr_clean <- corr_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    variable = if_else(Parameter1 %in% c("factor1", "factor2"), Parameter2, Parameter1),
    factor   = if_else(Parameter1 %in% c("factor1", "factor2"), Parameter1, Parameter2)
  ) %>%
  select(factor, variable, rho, CI_low, CI_high, p)


corr_clean <- corr_clean %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ ""
  ))

corr_clean$variable <- factor(corr_clean$variable, levels = c(
  "behavioral_activation",
  "emotional_sensitivity",
  "social_motivation",
  "Score_ASRM",
  "Score_CESD",
  "Score_SHPS"
))

poster_cor <- ggplot(corr_clean, aes(x = factor, y = variable, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), sig)), size = 7) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "pink", mid = "white", high = "light blue",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Spearman's ρ"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Vigor and RL with Questionnaires",
    x = "Latent Factor",
    y = "Variable"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_fixed()


# Filter out unwanted variables
corr_filtered <- corr_clean %>%
  filter(!variable %in% c("social_motivation", "emotional_sensitivity"))

# Create the plot with factors on rows and questionnaires on columns
poster_cor_horizontal <- ggplot(corr_filtered, aes(x = variable, y = factor, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), sig)), size = 7) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "pink", mid = "white", high = "light blue",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Spearman's ρ"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Vigor and RL with Questionnaires",
    x = "Questionnaire",
    y = "Latent Factor"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) 

# Step 1: Filter only the 8 correlations of interest
holm_df_OG <- corr_clean %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("Score_CESD", "Score_ASRM", "Score_SHPS", "behavioral_activation")) %>%
  filter(factor %in% c("factor1", "factor2")) %>%
  arrange(p)  # Optional: sort for clearer view

# Step 1: Filter only the 8 correlations of interest
holm_df <- corr_clean %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("Score_CESD", "Score_ASRM", "behavioral_activation")) %>%
  filter(factor %in% c("factor1", "factor2")) %>%
  arrange(p)  # Optional: sort for clearer view


# Step 2: Apply Holm correction
holm_df <- holm_df %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))

# Step 3: Add corrected significance stars
holm_df <- holm_df %>%
  mutate(sig_holm = case_when(
    p_holm < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_holm < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p_holm < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE           ~ ""
  ))

# View results
print(holm_df)

paper_cor_horizontal <- ggplot(holm_df, aes(x = variable, y = factor, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), sig_holm)), size = 7) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "pink", mid = "white", high = "light blue",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Spearman's ρ"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Vigor and RL with Questionnaires",
    x = "Questionnaire",
    y = "Latent Factor"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) 


```

# ICC 

#### Constrained quadratic

```{r icc-constrained-quadratic-prg}
###### Loadings method ######
# Make an intersection of PRG exclusion factor scores both for day 1 and day 2
data_icc_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_factor_scores <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_with_factors %>%
  select(subjID, factor1, factor2) %>%
  filter(subjID %in% data_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_with_factors$subjID)

data_icc_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_factor_scores <- data_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_with_factors %>%
  select(subjID, factor1, factor2)

# Make an intersection of PRG exclusion data of day 1 that are also in day 2
data_icc_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_retest <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg %>%
  filter(subjID %in% data_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg$subjID)

# Make an intersection of PRG exclusion data of day 2 that are also in day 1
data_icc_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_retest <- data_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg %>%
  filter(subjID %in% data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg$subjID)

# Get factor scores for participants on day 2 given the loadings from day 1
# Get loadings from the Day 1 FA
fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_loadings <- fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg$loadings[,1:2]
# Get loadings from the Day 2 FA
fa_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_loadings <- fa_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg$loadings[,1:2]
# Reduce the data to only the relevant columns
data_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_reduced <- data_icc_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_retest %>%
  select(rlwm_alpha, gng_beta, gng_eps, foraging_exit_threshold, k)

# Get factor scores for day 2 given the loadings from day 1
fa_scores_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg <- factor.scores(data_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_reduced, fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_loadings, method = "Thurstone")
fa_scores_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_scores <- fa_scores_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg$scores
# Calculate ICC for each day and model
factor1 <-  icc(cbind(data_icc_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_factor_scores[,2],fa_scores_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_scores[,1]), model = "twoway", type = "agreement", unit = "single")
factor2 <-  icc(cbind(data_icc_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_factor_scores[,3],fa_scores_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_scores[,2]), model = "twoway", type = "agreement", unit = "single")
icc_constrained_quadratic_prg_df <- data.frame(
  Factor = c("Factor1", "Factor2"),
  CI_upper = c(factor1$ubound, factor2$ubound),
  CI_lower = c(factor1$lbound, factor2$lbound),
  ICC = c(factor1$value, factor2$value)
)

icc_constrained_quadratic_prg_df

# Make a nice table out of it
# Rename Factor1 to Factor 1 (RL) and Factor 2 (Vigor)
icc_constrained_quadratic_prg_df$Factor <- recode(icc_constrained_quadratic_prg_df$Factor, 
                                                   "Factor1" = "Factor 1 (RL)", 
                                                   "Factor2" = "Factor 2 (Vigor)")

nice_icc_constrained_quadratic_prg_df <- nice_table(icc_constrained_quadratic_prg_df)
print(nice_icc_constrained_quadratic_prg_df, preview = "docx")


###### Correlation of loadings ######
fac1_cor_constr_quadratic_prg <- cor(fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_loadings[,1], fa_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_loadings[,1], method = "spearman")
fac2_cor_constr_quadratic_prg <- cor(fa_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_loadings[,2], fa_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_loadings[,2], method = "spearman")
print(fac1_cor_constr_quadratic_prg)
print(fac2_cor_constr_quadratic_prg)

###### ICC of parameters ######
# Get the common column names between df_1_retest_pp and df_2
variables <- intersect(names(data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg), names(data_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg))
variables <- variables[!variables %in% c("subjID")]  # Exclude factor columns

# List to store ICC results
icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg <- list()
for (variable in variables) {
  icc_result <- icc(cbind(data_icc_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_retest[[variable]], data_icc_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg_retest[[variable]]), 
                    model = "twoway", type = "agreement", unit = "single")
  
  icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg[[variable]] <- list(Variable = variable, 
                                                            LB = round(icc_result$lbound, 2), 
                                                            UB = round(icc_result$ubound, 2),
                                                            ICC = round(icc_result$value, 2))
}

# Convert list to dataframe
icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df <- do.call(rbind, icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg)
icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df <- as.data.frame(icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Fix the Variable column
icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df$Variable <- rownames(icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df)  # Use row names as the correct variable names
rownames(icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df) <- NULL  # Remove row names after extraction
# Convert numeric columns
icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df$LB <- as.numeric(icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df$LB)
icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df$UB <- as.numeric(icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df$UB)
icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df$ICC <- as.numeric(icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df$ICC)
icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df

# Make an output in nice_table
nice_icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df <- icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df %>%
  filter(Variable %in% c("rlwm_alpha", "gng_beta", "gng_eps", "foraging_exit_threshold", "k")) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = recode(Variable,
      "rlwm_alpha" = "RLWM Alpha",
      "gng_beta" = "GNG Beta",
      "gng_eps" = "GNG Epsilon",
      "foraging_exit_threshold" = "Foraging Exit Threshold",
      "k" = "Effort Kappa"
    ),
    CI_lower = LB,
    CI_upper = UB
  ) %>%
  select(Variable,  ICC,CI_lower, CI_upper)

# Make a nice table out of it
nice_icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df <- nice_table(nice_icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df)
print(nice_icc_params_constrained_quadratic_prg_df, preview = "docx")


```

# Outliers Day 1

### PRG Exclusion

#### Constrained quadratic

```{r}
# Assess the univariete outliers of the parameters using z scores
fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_normalized <- data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))

# Check the number of outliers per parameter
outliers_count_day1 <- fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_normalized %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),
                   ~ sum(abs(.) > 3),
                   .names = "outliers_{.col}"))

# Filter the rows with outliers
rows_with_outliers <- fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg_normalized %>%
  filter(if_any(where(is.numeric), ~ abs(.) > 3))


# Factor analysis using factanal
fa_data_day1_constrained_quadratic_prg <- data_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg %>%
  select(rlwm_alpha, gng_beta, gng_eps, foraging_exit_threshold, k)  # Exclude non-FA relevant columns

fa_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg <- factanal(
  fa_data_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg,
  factors = 2,
  rotation = "varimax",
  scores = "regression"
)

print(fa_day2_constrained_quadratic_prg)
```
